cases.name: local_update
cases.query: WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100)) UPDATE cte_scope_view SET n = (SELECT 1/n FROM c LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: local_delete
cases.query: WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100)) DELETE FROM cte_scope_view WHERE n > (SELECT 1/n FROM c LIMIT 1) RETURNING n

cases.name: outer_alias
cases.query: WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.host_rows(100)) UPDATE cte_scope_alias SET alias_n = (SELECT alias_n FROM c LIMIT 1) RETURNING alias_n
